description: This file defines functions and types for generating and updating event names, including parsing attendee names, replacing placeholders in event name templates, and validating custom event name strings within an event management system.

methods.name: parseName
methods.description: Parses attendee name which can be a string or an object with first and last name, returning a formatted string or 'Nameless'.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Generates an event name string based on event details, replacing placeholders with actual values, including location and attendee info.

methods.name: updateHostInEventName
methods.description: Replaces the host name in an event name string with a new host name, handling various name formats.

methods.name: validateCustomEventName
methods.description: Validates that a custom event name string contains only allowed placeholders, returning the offending placeholder if invalid.
